commonSettings.label: Idle session timeout (seconds)
commonSettings.description: Seconds a chat session stays warm after its last request. 0 keeps it until the agent stops.

commonSettings.label: Idle agent shutdown (minutes)
commonSettings.description: Stop the agent process after this many idle minutes (0 never). It restarts on the next request.

commonSettings.label: Dump requests (debug)
commonSettings.description: Write each request to a JSON file in the agent's folder. Files contain the full prompt; keep off unless debugging.

settings.label: Auth preference
settings.description: Credentials to use when both an API key and a signed-in account (OAuth) exist. Restarts the agent.
optionDescriptions: The saved API key if any, else the signed-in account.
The saved API key; without one, the signed-in account.
Always the signed-in account; ignores the saved key and key environment variables.

settings.label: Tool search
settings.description: Load the client's tools on demand. On: the model sees tool names and fetches a description when needed, so requests are much smaller but a tool's first use may take an extra lookup (not supported by every model, e.g. Haiku). Off: every description is sent each request. Restarts the agent.
optionDescriptions: Send every description with every request.

settings.label: Default thinking effort
settings.description: Thinking effort for a request that names none (such as a subagent) or asks for Default. Default leaves it to the agent, which may pick the costliest level. Levels the model lacks are ignored.

settings.label: Show thinking text
settings.description: On: responses include a summary of Claude's reasoning. Off: they don't. The model thinks, and tokens are billed, the same either way. Restarts the agent.

settings.label: Replace the Claude Code system prompt
settings.description: On: the client's system prompt replaces Claude Code's built-in prompt. Off: it is appended to it. Restarts the agent.

settings.label: Max live chat sessions
settings.description: Chats that may keep a live Claude process (about 100-200 MB each). Beyond this, the least recently used idle chat is closed; its next message resumes from disk, which is slower and misses the prompt cache. Minimum 1.

settings.label: Auth preference
settings.description: Credentials to use when both an OpenAI API key and a ChatGPT account exist. Restarts the agent.
optionDescriptions: The saved API key if any, else the ChatGPT account.
The saved API key; without one, the ChatGPT account.
Always the ChatGPT account; the saved key is ignored and CODEX_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY are withheld.

settings.label: Largest context window
settings.description: Use each model's largest context window instead of its default (models that can't be raised keep it). Compaction is delayed, so long chats re-send more history each turn and use plan limits faster. Restarts the agent.

settings.label: Default thinking effort
settings.description: Thinking effort for a request that names none (such as a subagent). Default leaves it to the agent. An effort a request names is kept; levels the model lacks are ignored.

settings.label: Replace the Codex system prompt
settings.description: On: Codex's built-in instructions, skills and environment notes are replaced by a one-line identity followed by the client's system prompt. Off: the client's prompt is added to Codex's own. Restarts the agent.

settings.label: Default thinking effort
settings.description: Thinking effort for a request that names none (such as a subagent). Default leaves it to the agent. An effort a request names is kept; levels the model lacks are ignored.

settings.label: Replace the Antigravity system prompt
settings.description: On: a neutral base identity replaces Antigravity's persona, followed by the client's system prompt. Off: a short Antigravity persona is kept, followed by the same prompt. Antigravity's generated prompt is replaced either way, but its skills, artifacts and messaging sections stay. Warning: Google answers a prompt it rejects with a 429 (Resource exhausted) on every request; if chats fail that way, turn this off. Restarts the agent.

settings.label: Auth preference
settings.description: Credentials to use when both a Gemini API key and a signed-in account exist. Restarts the agent.
optionDescriptions: The saved API key if any, else the signed-in account.
The saved API key; without one, the signed-in account.
Always the signed-in account; ignores the saved key and key environment variables.
